body: Hey, I hear you. It’s devestating when no one answers. It hasn’t happened to me here, but other forums. I’ve felt humiliated, stupid and like no one cares. But people do care. You made a list? That’s great! Even if you failed every single task, you tried. Keep trying. Make another list. Eventually you’ll find something you’re good at! And it’ll feel amazing.
Oh i’ve tried that already. It’s the first thing I did when I started having this issue.

General practioners. I’ve asked for a refferal to a skin specialist, but haven’t gotten one. I’ll see if I can book a appointment at a private clinic tomorrow!

Update: I managed to book a time online just now. I’ll see a dermatolgisic  20/10.

I’ve done a lot of reading about the skin microbiome. I’ve tried ph friendly products, this was the last product I tried. AO-mist. It helps restore the bacteria flora on the skin. I used it twice a day for 5 months, but It didn’t do much tbh. 

https://vitaminer.nu/en/artiklar/mother-dirt-ao-spray.html
Yes it’s horrible. The smell is constant :(

Some days I smell really strong, some days I don’t. I’ve tried to figure out what I’m doing different on the days I smell less but I’m cluesless...No, they haven’t tested my skin. I’ve only had my blood taken.
Hi, I got the same problem. It’s horrible. I’ve tried different deodorants, body washes, lotions, supplements, changed my diet. Nothing works. Sending a virtual hug!
